name: Creating Paradise
source:
The Church of True Peace is an organisation that works tirelessly to improve the world. As a faithful member of The Church, Fiona has many duties, including teaching new converts the rules that must be obeyed. In this gripping psychological thriller, explain the nature of sin, uphold the status quo, and trust in the words you know to be true.

After all, you wouldn’t want them to think that you’re lacking in faith, would you? 

[From [url=https://toomanyteethstudios.itch.io/creating-paradise]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
真正和平教会是一个孜孜不倦地致力于改善世界的组织。作为教会的忠实成员，菲奥娜有许多职责，包括教导新皈依者必须遵守的规则。在这部扣人心弦的心理惊悚片中，解释罪恶的本质，坚持现状，并相信你所知道的真实话语。

毕竟，你不希望他们认为你缺乏信心，不是吗？

[来自[url=https://toomanyteethstudios.itch.io/creating-paradise]itch.io[/url]]
